race.comment: DANCE VERSION (9) disappointed on debut in Saturday grade but has trialled nicely either side of the break. She now moves to the Fernie barn, though the recent trials stack up and she looks well placde in this event first-up. Can resume on a positive note. COBAR SKY (3) flew home first-up to miss in a photo as a 100-1 pop. He turned in a good rating there and returns to the scene of the crime with Nottle now on board. Creates plenty of interest on the back of the first-up effort. OUR ENCHANTRESS (6) improved last time out, finishing a nose from the winner in third at the end of 1100m at this track. Looks well placed so expect another big run. LOVESEXY (5) has to be included on her recent form. VIVALDA (4) can feature first-up despite the wide barrier.
